requirement_summary: External LLM / Provider Provenance Boundary: 외부 LLM/provider에 전달한 prompt/context/evidence와 반환된 output을 provider/version/region/retention/training-use policy와 함께 기록한다. 외부 provider 출력이 내부 provenance를 대체하지 않으며 training-use 금지 계약을 위반하는 재사용을 차단한다.
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.java (externalLlmProvenanceBoundaryCheck), assurance.learning.external-llm-provenance-boundary.check v2 operation; contracts/external-llm-provenance-boundary-check.v1.schema.json (NEW, built this pass)
observed_source: SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridgeTest (real dispatch through the full RBAC/workflow chain)
coverage_notes: Two independent real checks, either forcing REUSE_BLOCKED: (1) training_use_prohibited_by_contract=true combined with proposed_reuse_purpose=TRAINING_DATA -- a specific cross-field combination JSON Schema's per-field validation cannot forbid -- closing 'training-use 금지 계약을 위반하는 재사용을 차단한다'; the SAME prohibited contract still allows EVIDENCE_ONLY reuse, since the prohibition specifically targets training use. (2) internal_provenance_established=false always blocks REGARDLESS of the training-use fields, closing '외부 provider 출력이 내부 provenance를 대체하지 않으며' (external provider output can never substitute for real internal provenance).
open_gap: This operation validates the reuse-authorization DECISION given caller-declared facts (contract prohibition, provenance established); it does not itself independently verify the contract terms against a real, separately-maintained vendor-contract registry (no such registry currently exists in this codebase, similar to the disclosed gap in FR-LEARN-054's jurisdiction_basis). The retention_policy_ref and provider/version/region fields are captured and echoed (satisfying the recording obligation) but not independently cross-checked against a live policy source.
design_reference_gap: REQUIREMENT_WITHOUT_DESIGN: the trace scanner correctly excludes the requirement's own authority document (153_LEARNING_VALIDATION_GOVERNANCE_SOVEREIGNTY_AND_SUPPLY_CHAIN_REFINEMENT.md) as circular, and no other design document currently elaborates this specific mechanism -- a genuine, disclosed gap.
